summary: Independent verification of RECLAIM OS Phase 2A LIVE-mode readiness (no pytest used). Wrote a standalone script (/app/tests/live_mode_independent.py) that exercises all LIVE semantics against the PUBLIC preview URL with the owner session token, asserting via Mongo reads: 54 checks, 54 effective passes (1 initial failure was my own script bug reading /api/settings response shape — fixed; real state was correct). Verified mode isolation (separate razorpay TEST/LIVE docs), credential rejection both ways (rzp_test_ on LIVE -> 400, non-prefixed -> 400, rzp_live_ on TEST -> 400), masked write-only diagnostics (no key_secret/webhook_secret in any response; anonymous GET/PUT/POST/DELETE on all 6 live endpoints -> 401), activation gate (webhook 403 before activation, wrong phrase 400, 'ACTIVATE LIVE' 200, credential re-save RESETS activation), LIVE webhook security (bad signature -> 401 + security_events row; genuine raw-body HMAC -> processed mode=LIVE, provider_event source=LIVE/signature_verified=true; exact replay -> duplicate:true with duplicate_deliveries=1), cross-contamination (real TEST webhook secret signature fails on LIVE endpoint 401; LIVE secret fails on TEST endpoint 401), case source RAZORPAY_LIVE, LIVE action gates (emergency_stop -> policy STOP/no execution; default live_actions_enabled=false -> blocked:'LIVE_ACTIONS_DISABLED' + LIVE_ACTION_BLOCKED audit; after enabling -> executed with simulated=true and no attribution), honest connection test (status ERROR with real Razorpay 401 detail, diagnostics status ERROR, LIVE_CONNECTION_TEST_FAILED audit), full LIVE_* audit trail, DELETE live config (503 on live webhook afterwards). Frontend /integrations verified with Playwright: live-section, live-warning production text, write-only password inputs, activation box only when configured-and-not-activated, activate button disabled until exact phrase, activation succeeds, read-only LIVE connection test surfaces the honest 401 error in UI, no secrets rendered, TEST card still CONNECTED. All artifacts cleaned up; TEST razorpay doc (real creds, CONNECTED) and resend doc (enabled) byte-identical/untouched; settings reset to emergency_stop=false, live_actions_enabled=false.

ui_bugs.issue: LIVE credential inputs are NOT cleared after a successful save — key_id/key_secret/webhook_secret values stay in React state and in the DOM (as password fields). Backend is correctly write-only, but the client should reset the form after save so live secrets aren't retained in client memory/DOM.

issues: Amber/red warning + error blocks have good contrast; no layout/spacing defects found at 1920x1080. Status badge correctly flips NOT CONNECTED -> ACTIVE.

action_items: Optional (LOW): clear the LIVE credential form fields after a successful save so secrets are not retained client-side.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_integrations.py is 638 lines and frontend/src/pages/Integrations.jsx is 591 lines — both approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting the LIVE-mode block / LiveSection component before Phase 2B grows them further.
Security order in /api/webhooks/razorpay/live is correct (size limit -> configured+activated -> raw-body constant-time HMAC -> parse -> idempotency); no secrets logged. No changes needed.

execution.py enforces both gates (emergency_stop, live_actions_enabled) before every LIVE action and writes LIVE_ACTION_BLOCKED audits — verified end-to-end, no bypass found via the manual execute route.
